title: Triage the 50 open CodeQL alerts
goal: Each open alert is fixed with a failing test first, or listed with the reason it is a false positive
acceptance: Each of the 50 alerts is read at its location; a true positive gets a committed failing test, then the fix
Each false positive is listed in docs/verification.md#codeql-alert-triage with its number, rule, location, reason and the dismissal command
Alerts in the retired remove/ prototypes are either excluded from the analysis by a reviewed codeql.yml paths-ignore (with its reason) or listed
A true positive in the copied tools/work-usage.mjs is reported to the harness template, not fixed here
privacy: No secrets, tokens or personal data in the evidence; alert numbers and file locations only.
escalation: Dismissing an alert goes to the owner (B-152-T02)
A fix that changes a trust boundary gets a design review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 in the full audit: 50 alerts, most in tests and retired prototypes. Not a measurement.
